name: Bottom Bar
author: AlteringUX
description: A second bar along the bottom edge of every monitor that hosts overflow bar widgets the top bar has no room for. It instantiates the real alteringux.* BarWidget.qml files (stocks, score, conductor) and feeds them a minimal Bar host shim, so their labels, wheel/click behaviour, IPC handlers and KeyboardPanel popups all keep working unchanged — the popups use the shell's built-in barPos:"bottom" positioning. Follows the top bar's hide flag and adds its own show/hide/toggle IPC.
